title: Opening a Bank Account
situation: You go to a bank to open your first account and get a debit card.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Hello. What brings you in today?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I would like to open an account.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Did you bring your ID?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Yes, here is my alien registration card.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 여기 신청서에 성함하고 연락처 적어 주세요.
lines.en: Please write your name and phone number on this form here.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Can I get a debit card with it too?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 네, 가능해요. 비밀번호 네 자리 눌러 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, that is possible. Please enter a four-digit PIN.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I would also like to sign up for internet banking.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 그럼 휴대폰으로 본인 인증 한번 할게요.
lines.en: Then let me verify your identity with your phone.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: When does the card come out?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: I will issue it right now. One moment please.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Okay, thank you.

tip: Bring your 외국인등록증 (ARC) and a Korean phone number, since banks verify your identity by phone. New foreign accounts often start with a low daily transfer limit for fraud protection.

title: Asking About a Transfer
situation: You go to the bank counter to send money and ask about the transfer limit and fee.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Hello. I came to make a transfer.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 네, 받는 분 계좌번호 알고 계세요?
lines.en: Sure, do you know the recipient's account number?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.ko: 네, 여기 적어 왔어요. 백만 원 보내고 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, I wrote it down here. I want to send one million won.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Have you by any chance checked your transfer limit?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.ko: 한도가 얼마예요? 오늘 다 보낼 수 있어요?
lines.en: What is the limit? Can I send it all today?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 하루 한도가 백만 원이라서 딱 돼요.
lines.en: Your daily limit is one million won, so it works exactly.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: How much is the fee?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: If it is the same bank, it is free.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: What if it is a different bank?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 오백 원 붙어요. 비밀번호 눌러 주세요.
lines.en: There is a 500 won charge. Please enter your PIN.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Did it go through? Will I get a confirmation text?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 네, 이체 완료됐어요. 문자 갈 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, the transfer is complete. A text will be sent.

tip: If you hit your daily 이체 한도, you can raise it in the bank app or in person, though raising it usually needs extra verification. Transfers within the same bank are free, while inter-bank transfers add a small fee.

title: Move-in Report at the Community Center
situation: You go to the 주민센터 to report a change of address and pick up a residence document.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 번호표 뽑고 잠시만 기다려 주세요.
lines.en: Hello. Please take a number and wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Okay. I came to file a move-in report.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: What is your new address?
lines.note: polite way to ask for info

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I moved to Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu.

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: Could you show me your ID and lease contract?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: Here you go. How many days until it is processed?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.ko: 오늘 바로 처리돼요. 여기 서명해 주세요.
lines.en: It is processed today right away. Please sign here.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.ko: 그리고 주민등록등본도 한 통 떼고 싶어요.
lines.en: And I would also like to get one copy of a residence certificate.
lines.note: 등본 한 통 떼다 = print one copy of a certificate

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: The fee is 400 won—would you like to pay by card?

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: By any chance, can I get the document in English too?

lines.speaker: 직원
lines.en: An English document has to be requested separately.

lines.speaker: 손님
lines.en: I see. Then just the certificate please. Thank you.

tip: You must report a move within 14 days. Bring your ID and lease, and you can print a 주민등록등본 (residence certificate) at the same visit. Foreign residents may instead report at an immigration office, so check which applies to your visa.
